about: People who shoot at him: the police, gang members, the courthouse's metal detector and its search, the stash at the crib (scripts/combat_foes.gd reads this). Every number and every shouted line here is a placeholder, written on 2026-11-15 by the foes worker, not the owners' wording. Times are seconds, distances metres, health out of 100 (his: player_state.gd's MAX_HEALTH).

police.about: Officers (the cop drawing). One who can see him with a weapon in his hands shouts once, draws and fires until he is down, out of sight or has put it away. Put away with one of them close by, he is arrested.
police.why: put his gun away in front of the police

gang.about: At these places, each of `who` (a drawing's folder) carries a gun out of sight `odds` of the days, one of `weapons` (by weight). The dice are thrown for the place and the day, so a place is the same all day. A shot fired within `alert` of one of them, or passing within `pass` of him, or hitting him, and he draws and shoots back.

detector.about: The courthouse's metal detector: walking through it blinks its lamps green, or red with its light on top flashing if he has a firearm on him at all (in his hands or not).

search.about: After a red: the nearest officer who can walk up to him (only ever towards the camera, the way he faces) shouts `stop` after `react`, walks up beside him after `wait`, says `found` with the weapon in his hand and after `pat` he is arrested; one who cannot walk up calls him over (`come`). Run (`run_off` from where he was stopped) and they fire while he is on the move; once he has stood still for `still` the search goes on. Pull the weapon and the police rule above applies.
search.why: a firearm through the courthouse metal detector
